posts.title: Design With Intent: How We Begin Every Project
posts.excerpt: Great spaces don't start with a mood board — they start with how you actually live. A look inside the questions we ask before a single finish is chosen.
posts.body:
Every project at Drift begins the same way: not with a paint color, but with a conversation about life.

## Function first

Before we shape a single sightline, we map how a space will really be used — where the light lands in the morning, where people gather, where the quiet corners need to be. Only then does the design work begin.

## The details that matter

From the placement of furnishings to the flow between rooms, we design for the way a home is lived in and remembered. The result is a space that feels effortless — dynamic where it should be, calm where it needs to be.

That discipline is what turns a house into a home, and a project into something lasting.

posts.title: Staging That Sells: Why Presentation Moves Markets
posts.excerpt: In today's market, buyers decide in seconds. Here's how elevated, strategic staging helps a listing show its best — and sell faster.
posts.body:
A beautifully staged home doesn't just look better — it *sells* better.

## First impressions are everything

Buyers form an opinion within moments of walking in (or scrolling past a listing photo). Thoughtful staging highlights architecture, warms up empty rooms, and helps buyers picture themselves at home.

## Strategy, not just style

We stage to the market and the buyer — curated furnishings, considered styling, and a flow that photographs beautifully and shows even better in person. It's design in service of the sale.

Ask us about our **Pay-At-Close** option, which lets qualifying sellers defer their staging investment until the home sells.

posts.title: Permit-Ready: Building Faster With Pre-Approved Plans
posts.excerpt: Our library of ready-to-build plans — including The Si Plan, pre-approved in the City of Everett — can shorten your path from idea to groundbreaking.
posts.body:
Building a home is a big undertaking. Starting from an approved plan can make it dramatically simpler.

## What 'Basic Plan' approval means

In the City of Everett, our **Si Plan** is approved as a Basic Plan — cleared to build on an expedited permit with no modifications required. That means less time in review and a faster path to construction.

## A plan for the way you live

Every plan in our library can be built as-drawn or tailored with modifications. We'll walk you through pricing for the plan as-is and for any changes you have in mind.

Browse the library and ask which plans are approved in your jurisdiction.
